content.comment_body: Hello, I previously created a program in [product_name] [version_no], which was downloaded to [product_name] [version_no] and the configuration exported to [product_name] [version_no]. Everything ran smoothly. Now, I'm using newer hardware ([product_name] [version_no] FS4 and [product_name] [version_no]). After rewriting my program in [product_name] [version_no], I successfully downloaded everything to the updated hardware. However, when I try monitoring a bit from the [product_name] (e.g., M57) in the portal's data block, the bit does not update live and fails to toggle every second as expected. This issue did not occur with the older [product_name] hardware. Has anyone else experienced this with the new [product_name] [version_no] FS4 hardware?

I’m facing similar difficulties with the updated [product_name] [version_no] FS4. I use [product_name] together with HMI panels across multiple machines. When attempting to run a two-month-old program on the new hardware, two main issues appear: (1) Even after switching HW type to FS4 in [product_name] [version_no], the online test only briefly shows correct I/Q states before freezing and failing to update states or timer values, (2) HMI network input isn’t working. The previous version of [product_name] functioned correctly. Oddly, new programs created in the portal and [product_name] work fine for network I/Q and online testing. These inconsistencies are confusing.

I am experiencing the same issue. After swapping a [product_name] [version_no] FW3 with FW4, I cannot visualize data from the new device. Reverting to the previous FW3 device resolves the problem. Is there anyone from [company_name] who can clarify this situation?
To directly reach [company_name] via this forum, it's recommended to start a Support Request.

A newly posted question from [user_name] has been moved to its own thread with the title "[product_name] [version_no] FS4 & [product_name] [version_no]: Communication doesn't work." Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users recently upgrading to [product_name] [version_no] FS4 hardware in combination with [product_name] [version_no] and HMI panels are encountering data monitoring and visualization issues—such as failure to display live bit changes, freezing of online testing functions, and disruptions to HMI network input. These problems did not exist with the older hardware, pointing to a regression or compatibility conflict linked to the FS4 hardware or updated software releases.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the latest [product_name] [version_no] FS4 hardware and updated software ([product_name] [version_no]) will fully maintain compatibility and functionality with earlier versions, specifically in aspects related to monitoring, visualization, and seamless HMI communication, without introducing new issues.
